questions.stem: Using bond energies: H-H = 436 kJ/mol, Cl-Cl = 243 kJ/mol, H-Cl = 432 kJ/mol, calculate ΔH for H₂ + Cl₂ → 2HCl.
questions.explanation: Bonds broken: 1 H-H (436) + 1 Cl-Cl (243) = 679 kJ. Bonds formed: 2 H-Cl = 2 x 432 = 864 kJ. ΔH = 679 - 864 = -185 kJ/mol. The reaction is exothermic because more energy is released making bonds than is needed to break them.
